Name: TillableGround
Author: hawkfalcon
Description:
[color=#f1c232][size=6][b]Tillable Ground
[/b][/size][/color]
Have you ever wanted to till a specific spot but the game wouldn't let you?
Have you ever built the perfect farm just to not be able to get rid of a small corner of grass?
This mod is for you!

[b][color=#f1c232][size=4][u]Features
[/u][/size][/color][/b]Two great modes:
[b][color=#6aa84f]Make a tile tillable (default)[/color]
[/b]It allows you to make a tile *tillable* (AKA, you can use your hoe on it).
In the normal mode, just press H (now configurable!) to work the magic!
[b]The tile under your mouse cursor will now be tillable.
[/b]Press U (also configurable) to prevent a tile from being tillable.
[b][color=#6aa84f]
Allow tilling anywhere
[/color][/b]You can also set ﻿AllowTillingAnywhere in the config to make any tile tillable!
No need to press a button, you can now [b]till *any* tile.[/b]


[b]**Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]the latest version of SMAPI[/url][color=#f1f1f1] and SDV 1.3 beta**[/color][/b]
﻿Feel free to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Community#Discord]Chat on Discord[/url] if you have any issues or ideas!
[u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53568191?tab=user+files]Check out my other mods[/url][/u]
